baseline.phase2Fixture: portable schema v9 canonical V2 authority baseline
baseline.journeyPreimplementationRef: the Checkpoint 2 commit containing this protocol
notes: Phase 2 did not expose stable Roadmap-ready, selection-settled, long-task, or React commit markers, so no interaction timing is fabricated for that ref.
Checkpoint 3 must capture the first compliant interaction baseline before changing journey rendering and compare every subsequent run with that frozen result.
Absolute ceilings remain binding even when a Phase 2 relative comparison is unavailable.

measurementRunnerContract.topology: four shared foundation nodes feeding four domain-local branches, per-domain diamonds and multiple specialization parents, one cross-domain multi-dimension target, and cross-domain opposite-direction soft relationships
measurementRunnerContract.serverLifecycle: seed and build are completed before timing; the Checkpoint 3 runner keeps the disposable production stack alive only for the bounded measurements and destroys it afterward
measurementRunnerContract.coldMode: new browser context, HTTP cache disabled, first timed canonical /roadmap navigation after authentication
measurementRunnerContract.warmMode: same browser context after one unmeasured ready navigation; HTTP cache enabled; timed page reload without reseeding or rebuilding projection
measurementRunnerContract.navigationWindow: performance.timeOrigin/navigationStart through data-roadmap-ready=true; includes route fetch, parse, projection GET, view-model construction, and first interactive Map or Outline
measurementRunnerContract.selectionWindow: trusted activation timestamp for the declared target through data-roadmap-detail-settled=<node-id>; run alternating keyboard and pointer samples
measurementRunnerContract.longTaskWindow: PerformanceObserver longtask entries whose startTime falls within the timed navigation or selection window; report count and total duration separately for each window
measurementRunnerContract.reactCommitWindow: production-safe probes count Roadmap page renders and custom journey-node renders after declared target activation and stop at detail-settled; all representative nodes remain mounted in measurement-only geometry mode so the runner gates both values and parent renders cannot hide whole-canvas React Flow descendant churn
measurementRunnerContract.chunkDiscovery: frontend/dist/.vite/manifest.json keys index.html and lazy dynamic entry src/features/roadmap/v2.ts
measurementRunnerContract.chunkCompression: Python gzip.compress level=9 with mtime=0 over emitted JavaScript; recursively include every static import required by the Roadmap dynamic entry and the shared application entry exactly once, exclude CSS and unrelated dynamic siblings

readyMarkers.roadmapReady: data-roadmap-ready=true after the active view and controls are interactive
readyMarkers.layoutComplete: the pure build_layout call has returned all canonical positions

journeyNodeRendersPerSelection.notes: Complementary descendant-render gate added before the first compliant Checkpoint 3 baseline; its ceiling permits the seven-node target/prerequisite closure to mount while preventing whole-canvas churn.

includes: shared application chunk required by the route

checkpoint2PureLayoutObservation.status: informational reference; rerun on the declared reference environment

checkpoint3FirstCompliantObservation.measurementMode: Production Map with measurement-only all-node geometry; Fit all and an untimed viewport pan that clears the fixed navigation complete before timing while the full representative canvas remains mounted; trusted click/keydown timestamp through settled detail; all journey-node renders are counted.
checkpoint3FirstCompliantObservation.status: First compliant Checkpoint 3 full-canvas observation; raw audited runs are retained for this checkpoint session at /tmp/lcc-roadmap-v3-100-final-all-nodes.json and /tmp/lcc-roadmap-v3-250-final-all-nodes.json.

reviewRules.subjectivePanZoomFeel: record separately; it is not a substitute for trace, long-task, or timing evidence
